title: Depth bound for the full decision tree
statement: Let $f\colon\{0,1\}^n \to \{0,1\}$ be a Boolean function on $n$ variables, let $k \le n$, and let $acc$ be a partial assignment of the variables. Then the full decision tree for $f$ that queries the variables $k, k+1, \dots, n-1$ in order starting from $acc$ has depth at most $n - k$.
hypotheses_covered: f is a Boolean function on n variables
replaced:
For a function $f$, an index $k \le n$, and an accumulator assignment $acc$, the complete
decision tree $\mathrm{buildFullDTree}\,f\,k\,acc$ that queries variables
$k, k+1, \dots, n-1$ in order has depth at most $n - k$.
